items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Handles user authentication with the remote API (server address input; SignIn opens the browser, or connect Username and Password), manages access tokens, keeps one connection alive for all requests and provides a unified catalog cache (identities and snapshots stored independently, mesh PLY geometry cached per snapshot). Stores authentication state in scriptcontext.sticky.
